_meta.note: Same picks/bans_made/bans_against shape as team_pick_ban_stats.json, but computed ONLY from matches BEFORE TI2026's Group Stage (everything except league_id 19719) - raw unweighted counts. Each hero entry carries both a raw count and a rate (count / team's games in this bucket). Complementary to team_pick_ban_stats_group_stage.json; together they partition the same underlying h2h_matches.json with no overlap.
